verdict.reason: The pack explains the machine-first business model and product routing clearly enough for owner/internal review, but billing, legal terms, usage ledger, pricing proof, concrete output samples, and product selector logic still need improvement before live sale.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: The machine has no starting list and needs coherent targets for a sector, area, and commercial objective.
product_reviews.value: Solves the no-list problem and creates a target base for later scoring.
product_reviews.risk: Targets must be coherent with the declared commercial objective, not generic names.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Market pre-check contract, delivery timing, source policy, and quality guarantee.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: The machine already has domains or companies and needs prioritization.
product_reviews.value: Gives score, confidence, decision, spend policy, reason, priority, and next product.
product_reviews.risk: Score alone can look generic unless decision logic and next purchase are explicit.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Calibration evidence, benchmark samples, and score-to-priority proof.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: After a strong score, before buying Action Pack or spending more budget.
product_reviews.value: Turns a score into evidence, gates, stop rules, and next-machine-call guidance.
product_reviews.risk: Can sound abstract without a full synthetic output example.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Fully worked Deep Analysis sample with evidence matrix and decision gate.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: Only after Deep Analysis confirms the opportunity.
product_reviews.value: Provides operational CRM/workflow payloads, approval gates, webhook/event schema, and guardrails.
product_reviews.risk: The buyer machine may not understand the premium price without a concrete payload example.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Fully worked Action Pack sample with CRM patch, workflow payload, webhook event, approval gate, and no-human-outreach guardrail.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: Light recurring API access and ongoing testing.
product_reviews.value: Simple recurring entry plan with 500 valid scores/month and basic usage report.
product_reviews.risk: Live subscription requires billing, VAT/legal handling, key management, rate limits, overage rules, and customer-visible usage tracking.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Keep simulated until checkout, terms, limits, usage ledger, and support model are production-ready.

product_reviews.when_to_buy: Recurring workflow volume, CRM/API platform use, webhook support, and higher monthly usage.
product_reviews.value: Scalable recurring product with scores, Deep Analysis, Opportunity Feed, webhook support, and advanced reporting.
product_reviews.risk: EUR 499/month may be too low if data provider costs, agent runtime, webhook support, and quality checks are expensive.
product_reviews.future_monetization_need: Validate unit economics before offering live.

recommended_next_product_improvement.name: Product Selector Contract
recommended_next_product_improvement.purpose: Help a machine select the correct product based on buyer state, required inputs, expected outputs, price, blocked actions, and next allowed products.

final_verdict: GO for internal owner approval draft; NO-GO for monetization or external distribution until product selector, concrete examples, unit economics, usage ledger, billing/legal terms, and quality thresholds are completed.
